title: Hellfire Ramparts
body: The Hellfire Ramparts are the battlements on the outer face of Hellfire Citadel, the first of its defenses that any attacker from the peninsula must climb. The Fel Horde holds them in strength: Bonechewer and Bleeding Hollow warriors walk the walls, Shattered Hand warhounds wait to be loosed, and Watchkeeper Gargolmar commands the watch. A demon, Omor the Unscarred, holds a stretch of the wall, and at the far end a herald circles overhead on his drake.

parts.body: Honor Hold and Thrallmar, caught between the citadel and the Legion, mean to break the walls while the Legion's eyes are on the Dark Portal, so that an army can come close enough to strike at the fortress.

title: Vazruden the Herald
body: Vazruden the Herald guards the far end of the Hellfire Ramparts, circling above it on his drake Nazan until he comes down to meet intruders himself. Soon, he promises, their people will kneel to his lord. Whose herald he is he does not say, though the fel orcs of the citadel name no lord but Kargath Bladefist.

parts.body: On his body was a letter sealed with a blood-red I, and it was signed by Illidan. The Fel Horde may call Kargath warchief, but their herald answered to the Betrayer.
